component.name: HashChat
component.summary: Maximum anonymity messenger built with Haskell + Rust. Tor-only. Strongest OPSEC focus.

description.p: HashChat is a privacy-first, metadata-resistant messenger designed for high-risk environments. It uses real Double Ratchet cryptography, Tor hidden services by default, burner profiles, and an extremely aggressive panic wipe feature.
Built for people who need serious protection against advanced adversaries.
